words.meaning: the feeling or idea a word suggests beyond its basic meaning
words.example: The word cheap has a negative connotation, so I used affordable instead.

words.meaning: to make something seem less important or noticeable
words.example: The technical issues overshadowed an otherwise strong presentation.

words.meaning: to argue about a small or unimportant detail
words.example: I do not want to quibble over wording if we agree on the main idea.

words.meaning: to react with annoyance or defensiveness
words.example: She bristled when her manager questioned the quality of her work.

words.meaning: done in separate parts instead of all at once
words.example: We made piecemeal updates to the policy throughout the year.

phrases.meaning: a casual way to say no thanks or that you do not need anything
phrases.example: Do you want another coffee? No, I'm good, thanks.

phrases.meaning: used to show surprise or to agree that something is obvious
phrases.example: No kidding, that traffic was worse than usual today.

phrases.meaning: I feel the same way or have the same situation
phrases.example: I am ready for the weekend. Same here.

phrases.meaning: I forgot about it by accident
phrases.example: I meant to call you back, but it slipped my mind.
Good call booking the earlier flight before prices went up.
